side_missions.title: Signal Anomaly Report
side_missions.description: League intelligence has flagged unusual crystal resonance signatures emanating from the Fairy Realms. Commander Dave dispatches a recon detail to assess the tactical implications. If these crystals are evolving, the League needs to know first.

objectives.description: Deploy League sensor arrays at the resonance epicenter
Collect and analyze harmonic frequency data
Submit findings to League High Command

side_missions.title: Operation Pride Watch
side_missions.description: The Lion Dominion's internal fractures present both a threat and an opportunity for the League. Dave is ordered to embed an intelligence asset in Lord Mane's court — quietly, before the shooting starts.

objectives.description: Establish a diplomatic cover in Lion territory
Identify the factions within the Dominion power struggle

side_missions.title: Data Intercept
side_missions.description: League signals intelligence has identified a data broker at the Twilight Bazaar selling classified crystal reserve assessments. Dave needs to intercept the sale and secure the data for the League — or destroy it.

objectives.description: Locate the data broker in the Bazaar
Intercept the data before the sale completes
Extract from the Bazaar with the data intact

side_missions.title: Operation Cold Trail
side_missions.description: League patrols have been disappearing in the Fairy Realms sector. No mayday, no wreckage recovery. Dave takes it personally — those were his people. He will find out what happened, and someone will answer for it.

objectives.description: Retrace the last known patrol routes of missing ships
Identify and engage whatever is taking League ships
